name: Reboot Cafe Ogikubo
address: B1F Gloria Bldg, 5-30-12 Ogikubo, Suginami-ku, Tokyo
description: A purpose-built focus-work cafe near Ogikubo's south exit where every one of its roughly 21 spacious desk seats has its own power outlet and free Wi-Fi.

name: Cafe Veloce Ogikubo West Exit
nameJa: カフェ・ベローチェ 荻窪駅西口店
address: 1F Ogikubo Shogyo Bldg, 1-18-15 Kamiogi, Suginami-ku, Tokyo
description: A large, cheap chain coffee shop a few minutes from Ogikubo's west exit that offers free Wi-Fi and outlets across a good share of its 160 seats.

name: Komeda Coffee Ogikubo South Exit
nameJa: コメダ珈琲店 荻窪南口店
description: A roomy Komeda branch south of Ogikubo Station with its own free Wi-Fi and outlets available at essentially all seats, good for long sits.

name: Beck's Coffee Shop Ogikubo
nameJa: ベックスコーヒーショップ 荻窪店
description: A budget station-side coffee shop by Ogikubo's west exit offering free Wi-Fi, with power outlets limited mainly to counter seating.

name: Starbucks Coffee Lumine Ogikubo
nameJa: スターバックス コーヒー ルミネ荻窪店
description: The Starbucks inside Lumine Ogikubo has free Wi-Fi and outlets concentrated at counter seats, typical for a Tokyo mall branch.

name: Tully's Coffee Seibu Shinkin Ogikubo
nameJa: タリーズコーヒー 西武しんきん荻窪店
description: A compact Tully's near Ogikubo's south exit with free Wi-Fi and outlets available mostly at its counter seats.

name: Doutor Coffee Koenji South Exit
nameJa: ドトールコーヒーショップ 高円寺南口店
description: A two-floor Doutor a minute from Koenji's south exit with free Wi-Fi and power outlets at nearly all of its 65 seats.

name: Kissashitsu Renoir Koenji North Exit
nameJa: 喫茶室ルノアール 高円寺北口駅前店
description: A spacious retro-styled Renoir tea room by Koenji's north exit with widely spaced seats, free Wi-Fi and outlets at roughly half the tables.

name: Pronto Koenji South Exit
nameJa: プロント 高円寺南口店
description: A daytime-cafe, evening-bar Pronto near Koenji's south exit offering free Wi-Fi with outlets along its wall counter and a handful of center tables.

name: Coworking Cafe-Bar mui
nameJa: コワーキングカフェ・バー mui
description: A small white-interior coworking cafe-bar a few minutes from Koenji Station with free Wi-Fi and power at every seat, plus meeting-room options.

name: Yonchome Cafe
description: A long-running retro cafe with antique furnishings near Koenji's south exit offering free Wi-Fi and outlets at some seats.

name: Starbucks Coffee Asagaya Ekimae
nameJa: スターバックス コーヒー 阿佐ヶ谷駅前店
description: A Starbucks by Asagaya's west exit with free Wi-Fi and power outlets at counter and select seats among its 70 seats.

name: Cafe & Bar Pronto Beans Asagaya
nameJa: カフェ&バー プロント Beans阿佐ヶ谷店
description: A Pronto directly at Asagaya's south exit with free Wi-Fi and outlets set into the window counter overlooking the station.

name: Coffee & Bake Achoo!
description: A small specialty-coffee and bakery cafe by Asagaya's east exit with free Wi-Fi and outlets reported at all of its roughly 22 seats.

name: Penguin Cafe Asagaya
description: A relaxed specialty-coffee cafe north of Asagaya Station with free Wi-Fi and power outlets available at all seats.

name: LifeWork Cafe Nishi-Ogikubo
description: One of Tokyo's largest coworking-cafes, right by Nishi-Ogikubo Station, with full Wi-Fi coverage, ample outlets and drop-in day passes.
